title: test(dogfood): boot PlatformObjectsPlugin in the Setup/Account entry-view roster, so sys_exchange_rate resolves
body:
Refs #27813
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:dogfood 测试 `platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts` 的组装名单里加上 `PlatformObjectsPlugin`(只注册对象、不贡献导航),让 Setup 的「汇率」入口指向的 `sys_exchange_rate` 能被解析到。
- 为什么改:`sys_exchange_rate` 上线后(#27246),main 上每次 push 的 `Dogfood Regression Gate (2/3)` 都红在该文件的「入口指向的对象两个来源都没有声明」断言;这是该测试自己写明的修法,不是兜底。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个私有测试包里的测试文件,不动产品代码、不发布;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/dogfood/test/platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts` 的新名单条目(`apps: []`)和 Reach 段新增的说明。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts`,预期 52/52 通过;删掉新条目再跑,预期只红 `named objects neither source declares: ['sys_exchange_rate']` 一条。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/qa/dogfood/test/platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts` boots the Setup and Account composition and requires every object a merged `type: 'object'` entry names to be declared by the composition's registry or by the identity barrel. The Setup contribution `nav_exchange_rates` (in `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS`, shipped by `@objectstack/setup`) opens `sys_exchange_rate`. That object is registered by `PlatformObjectsPlugin` (`packages/platform-objects/src/plugin.ts`, the `objects: [SysMigration, SysMigrationJournal, SysSecret, SysExchangeRate, SysTrustedKey]` manifest in `init`). The test's roster did not boot that plugin, so the catalogue assertion went red on every `main` push since `194e66c0` (#27246).

The fix adds `PlatformObjectsPlugin` to the test's roster as an **object-only registrant** (`apps: []`). It lands no nav id, so it adds no row to the per-app "lands at least one navigation id" invariant. The Reach section of the file header and the remedy comment on the assertion now say that an object-only registrant goes into this roster alone. The production composition boots the same plugin (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`), so this makes the test's composition closer to the real one. No product code changes. No fallback, skip or exclusion is added.

**`check-app-nav-i18n`'s roster is unchanged, and this was measured.** The triage remedy says to add the plugin there too. That gate's `CONTRIBUTORS` is a NAV roster: every entry must land a nav id, and its header records that widening it with a non-nav entry was refused. Both ways of adding the plugin go red. Each probe was a one-time disk mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD afterwards:

- `apps: ['setup']`: the run fails with `@objectstack/platform-objects (H3 probe) landed NO setup navigation id`.
- `apps: []`: the self-test fails with `every CONTRIBUTORS entry declares at least one app IN the population`.

That gate also already judges `nav_exchange_rates`'s labels, because the entry comes from `@objectstack/setup`. It is green unchanged: `OK (12 contributor(s), 4 locale(s), 2 app(s) — setup: 55 merged nav id(s) ...)`.

## Acceptance notes

- The `Dogfood Regression Gate` shards do not run on `pull_request` or in the merge queue. They run on `main` push and on the schedule only. The first CI reading of this fix is therefore the post-merge `main` push. The local runs above are the evidence for this PR.
- The header says the roster "mirrors" `check-app-nav-i18n`'s `CONTRIBUTORS`, and that was already inexact before this PR. That gate also boots `@objectstack/service-settings`, and this test does not. The plugin contributes only `nav_settings_branding`, which is `type: 'url'`, so no object entry is missing from this test's population. This is noted only, not filed (carrier: none).

- The derived gate list is `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 51 commands. Every command was run with its exit code written to disk before any pipe. 50 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, because eight packages outside this diff have no `dist/`. That one is NOT MEASURED locally and is left to CI.
